invariants.rationale: restoreInstantTimestamp is likely required for a restore operation and should not be null at method entry.
savepointToRestoreTimestamp is likely required for a restore operation and should not be null at method entry.
restoreInstantTimestamp probably references a specific instant and should not be empty.
savepointToRestoreTimestamp likely references a specific savepoint and should not be empty.
Restoring to the same instant as the savepoint may be disallowed, so these should typically be different.
